text:
Sam Rinzel has seven assists in his last three games, three of them in Tuesday's 6-3 win over Toronto, as The Athletic's Mark Lazerus noted. The 22-year-old has 12 points in 20 games, six on the power play, and his ice time is up to nearly 22 minutes a night.

Our numbers call the hot run earned. He has 10 points in his last ten games when we'd expect about 4.5 at his ice time, and he's getting more chances of his own too. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking backs up the style: he carried the puck in on 47% of his entries last season and got to the dangerous ice in front of the net more than 93% of defensemen.

The luck is in the goals around him: Chicago has scored 5.2 more than its chances deserved with him on, and at five on five the Blackhawks get only 44% of the expected goals with him out there. Defensemen picked 20th to 30th since 2005 scored a median 0.23 points a game in their first full season. He's at 0.60. With Connor Bedard hurt Tuesday, The Athletic's Scott Powers has Rinzel on the top power-play unit.
